tools.name: list_vehicle_models
tools.description: List the models (and the years available) for a given Chaiz make id. Get the make id from list_vehicle_makes.

tools.name: search_plans_by_vehicle
tools.description: Search Chaiz for vehicle service contract (extended warranty) plans by make, model, and year. Results are 36-month (3-year) term plans. Returns plan cards with monthly and total price, coverage term, coverage level, rating, and links to chaiz.com. All of make, model, year, mileage, and state are req

tools.name: lookup_vehicle
tools.description: Fuzzy-match a vehicle by make (and optional model/year) to confirm it exists and correct spelling before a plan search. Use this when the user's make/model looks misspelled or uncertain.

tools.name: list_vehicle_makes
tools.description: List the vehicle makes (manufacturers) Chaiz supports. Use this to map a user's make to its id before listing models.

tools.name: search_plans_by_license_plate
tools.description: Search Chaiz for vehicle service contract plans by US license plate. The plate plus state is used to identify the vehicle. Results are 36-month (3-year) term plans. License plate, state, and mileage are required. If mileage is missing, ASK the user — never guess.

tools.name: search_plans_by_vin
tools.description: Search Chaiz for vehicle service contract plans by VIN. The VIN is decoded to the vehicle automatically. Results are 36-month (3-year) term plans. VIN, mileage, and state are required. If mileage or state is missing, ASK the user — never guess.
